content: a. UV-Visible spectroscopy: Introduction, theory, laws

spectroscopy, b. IR spectroscopy: Theory, modes of molecular
vibrations, sample handling, instrumentation of dispersive and

frequencies, and applications of IR spectroscopy, c
Spectrofluorimetry: Theory of fluorescence, factors affecting

NMR spectroscopy: Quantum numbers and their role in NMR
Principle, Instrumentation, Solvent requirement in NMR, Relaxation

principles of FT-NMR and 13C NMR. Applications of NMR
spectroscopy

Spectroscopy, Different types of ionization like electron impact
